Definition: something prolonged or tall, i.e. a vial or salt-cellar
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsᵉlôchîyth is the word for a vial, a small jar. It appears once, in 2 Kings 2:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsᵉlôchîyth is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
